Where should I leave the medical forms?
Just hand them to the receptionist at the front desk.
Yes, he has a medical degree from a university in Boston.
When does the spring semester start?
Classes begin on the second Monday of January.
About two hundred students signed up.
The seminar is in room two hundred four, on the left.
Haven't you filed the insurance claim yet?
I sent it in on Monday, but I haven't heard back.
It's the second door on the left.
The policy covers fire and flood damage, but not theft.
Could you transfer fifty dollars to my savings account?
Certainly, I just need to see your identification.
Yes, the transfer student from Spain arrived this morning.
The savings were lower than last year.
Who's going to present the new health program?
At the staff meeting on Friday afternoon.
Dr. Okafor volunteered to do it.
The clinic opens at eight, doesn't it?
A walk-in visit costs about thirty dollars, I believe.
Yes, but the doctors don't see patients until nine.
I opened a new account last week.
How long is the course on financial planning?
It runs for six weeks, two evenings a week.
The classroom is long and narrow, with no windows.
Yes, I planned to attend it.
Why was the student loan application rejected?
Because a signature was missing on the last page.
I'd like to apply for the evening shift.
Would you like to schedule your annual checkup now?
The annual report is on your desk, next to the folder.
Yes, do you have anything available next Thursday?
Did the bank approve your mortgage?
Not yet, they're still reviewing my income statements.
He approved the budget last week.
I'm looking for a three-bedroom house near the school downtown.
Which insurance plan did you choose?
The one that includes dental coverage.
I chose to take the stairs.
No, I haven't met the new plan manager yet.
I think the lecture has been moved to Room 5.
No, I haven't met the new lecturer from Canada.
Yes, the notice went up this morning.
What time is your appointment with the dentist?
It's at half past two this afternoon.
The dentist retired about two years ago, I think.
If the premium goes up, will you change companies?
I might, depending on what the competitors offer.
Yes, he is a premium member.
The company is on the second floor of that building.
Do you know whether the pharmacy delivers?
It's next to the post office on Main Street.
Yes, for orders over twenty dollars.
Our tuition fees have increased by ten percent.
I'll pay with a credit card, thanks.
That's a lot, has the school explained why?
Ten students passed the final exam last June.
You should have told the nurse about your allergy.
I know, I completely forgot to mention it.
No, I'm not allergic to anything else, thankfully.
She should be here at three o'clock.
Where can I get a copy of my bank statement?
You can print one from the mobile app.
Yes, I made a copy of the contract.
How many students signed up for the workshop?
He signed the registration form for me this morning.
Only eleven so far, but registration is still open.
Isn't the physical therapy session free for employees?
Our employees work on the second floor of the new building.
No, only the first one is, then it's fifteen dollars each.
Let's ask the advisor about a student discount.
No, I don't have the discount code.
Good idea, maybe we can open the account today too.
She was advised to take a day off after the long trip.
Who should I contact about a billing error?
The building is on Elm Street, across from the old bank branch.
Call the customer service line, the number is on your card.
When will the test results be ready?
The lab is on the ground floor, behind the pharmacy.
They should be back by the end of the week.
Do you prefer to pay monthly or annually?
Yes, I prefer the window seat.
Monthly would be easier for my budget.
The annual meeting is in April.
The vaccination clinic is running out of staff.
It runs every morning at nine, except on Sundays and holidays.
I could ask a few volunteers from my department.
Yes, the vaccine is very effective.
Hello, this is Daniel Park. I need to reschedule my appointment with Dr. Evans.
Certainly, Mr. Park. Your appointment is tomorrow at ten, correct?
That's right, but I have to attend a client meeting that morning.
I see. Dr. Evans has an opening on Thursday at four. Would that work?
Thursday is fine. Do I need to bring anything?
Please bring your insurance card and the list of medications you currently take.
Professor Nolan, I'd like to drop my statistics course and take economics instead.
The deadline for changing courses is this Friday, so you still have time. Why the change?
I realized statistics isn't required for my major, and economics would count toward my degree.
That makes sense. You'll need a signature from the economics department, though. Their office closes at noon on Fridays.
Then I'll go there tomorrow morning. Is there a fee for changing?
No fee before the deadline. After that, it costs fifty dollars.
Good morning. I'm opening a small bakery, and I'd like to set up a business account.
Congratulations! You'll need your business license, a photo ID, and proof of address.
I have the license and ID with me, but my utility bill is at home. Will a lease agreement do?
Yes, a signed lease is fine. There's a monthly fee of twenty-five dollars, but we waive it if your balance stays above five thousand.
That's useful. I'll deposit eight thousand to start.
Excellent. Let me print the forms for you.
Hi, I'm calling about the claim for the water damage in my basement.
Mr. Torres, thanks for calling. I've asked my supervisor, Mr. Hill, to join us because the repair estimate is quite high.
Hello, Mr. Torres. Our inspector visited on Monday, and his report says the pipe was old but properly maintained.
So will the policy cover the repairs?
Yes, up to fifteen thousand dollars. The estimate is twelve thousand, so you're covered. You'll pay a deductible of five hundred.
I'll email you the approval letter today. A contractor can begin as soon as you sign it.
Have you enrolled in the new health plan yet? I heard the deadline is the end of this month.
Not yet. HR sent an email last week, but I haven't had time to read the details.
I compared the two options. The premium plan costs more, but it includes dental and vision.
I rarely go to the dentist, so the basic plan might be enough.
Well, if you wear glasses like me, the vision coverage alone could save you money.
Good point. I'll look at the prices tonight and enroll tomorrow.
Principal Wells, the science museum trip is next Wednesday, but only twenty-two of the thirty permission slips have come back.
That's less than I expected. Have you sent a reminder to the parents?
I did, by email on Monday. I'll also call the families who haven't replied.
Good. Remember that the bus company needs the final number by Friday noon.
Understood. If a few students can't go, would it be possible to use a smaller bus?
I'll ask the company. A smaller bus would also reduce the cost.
Here is your prescription, Mr. Adams. Unfortunately, your insurance doesn't cover this brand.
Oh no. How much is it without coverage?
Sixty-eight dollars. But there's a generic version that's covered, and it costs only ten dollars.
It has the same active ingredient. Dr. Lee can approve the change if you'd like.
Please call her. I'll wait here and look at the vitamins while you do.
Thanks for joining, everyone, especially Lena from the IT department. We're here to talk about the new patient scheduling software that launches Monday.
I tried the training version, Lena. It's faster, but I couldn't find the button to add a patient's allergies.
That's my fault. The field is under the Medical History tab, not on the main page. I'll send a short guide to all the nurses this afternoon.
Please do. Also, we'll keep paper schedules at the front desk for the first week as a backup.
That's reassuring. Will the system be down at any point during the switch?
Only on Sunday night, for about two hours.
I'd like to know the interest rate for a five-year personal loan.
Today it's six point five percent, fixed. Are you borrowing for a particular purpose?
I want to renovate my kitchen. I'm hoping to borrow twenty thousand dollars.
With that amount, your monthly payment would be about three hundred ninety dollars. Keep in mind that rates change every Monday.
Then I'd better complete the application today.
That would be wise. I'll need your last three pay stubs.
Excuse me, I can't access the online journals from my dorm room. It keeps asking for a password.
You need to log in with your student number, not your email address. Have you tried that?
No, I used my email. Let me try again... It worked! Thanks.
Also, if you plan to study late, the library stays open until midnight during exam week.
That's great. Is it possible to reserve a study room?
Yes, you can book one online for up to three hours, but you must cancel if you don't need it.
Mr. Clarke, your cleaning is covered twice a year, but your insurance won't pay for the whitening.
I didn't ask for whitening. The dentist mentioned it as an option, I think.
Right, it's listed on your invoice by mistake. I'll remove it. Your total is forty dollars for the checkup.
That's fine. Could I schedule my next cleaning for six months from now?
Of course. How about the fourteenth of next June at nine?
Perfect. Please send me a reminder by text.
We have a budget of eight hundred dollars for the staff wellness day. Maria, what do you suggest?
A yoga session in the morning and a talk by a nutritionist after lunch.
Thanks, Maria. Tom, what do you think?
I'd rather book a massage therapist. Last year's yoga class was too crowded.
The nutritionist charges five hundred, and the therapist charges three hundred an hour.
Then we can't afford both. Let's keep the nutritionist and do a free walking challenge instead.
Fair enough. I'll write the announcement and send it before Friday.
Hi, I got a text saying there was a suspicious payment on my card, but I didn't make any purchases today.
Let me check. Yes, there's a charge of nine hundred dollars from an electronics store in another city.
That wasn't me. My card has been in my wallet all day.
Then I'll block the card immediately and issue a new one. It should arrive within five business days.
Will I be responsible for the charge?
No, you won't. We'll investigate and refund the amount, usually within ten days.

Attention all visitors. Beginning next Monday, visiting hours at Northfield General Hospital will change. Visitors will be welcome from one to eight in the evening instead of from noon to six. Children under twelve may visit only on weekends, and must be accompanied by an adult. Please stop at the information desk in the main lobby to pick up a free visitor badge before going to any floor. Thank you for helping us keep our patients safe.

Good afternoon, Ms. Ortega. This is Peter Gray from Harbor Insurance, returning your call about your car claim. I've reviewed the photos you sent, and everything looks fine, but I still need a copy of the police report. You can upload it to our website or fax it to my office. Once I have it, I can finish the review within two business days. If you'd rather discuss it, call me back at extension 214 before five today.

Welcome to Clearwater University, everyone. My name is Julia, and I'll be your guide for today's campus tour, which lasts about ninety minutes. We'll begin at the science building, then walk through the library and the student center. Photography is welcome everywhere except inside the laboratories. At the end of the tour, you're invited to a free lunch in the cafeteria, where you can meet current students. If you have any questions, please ask along the way.

Are you tired of low interest on your savings? At Summit Bank, our new Smart Saver account pays three point two percent, three times the national average. There are no monthly fees, and you can open an account in minutes with our mobile app. Open your account before the end of April, and we'll add a fifty-dollar bonus when you deposit at least five hundred dollars. Visit summitbank dot com or stop by any branch today.

This is your morning health report on Radio Metro. Doctors at the City Health Department say that flu cases have doubled in the past two weeks, and they are encouraging everyone, especially people over sixty-five, to get vaccinated. Free vaccinations are available at all public libraries on Tuesdays and Thursdays from nine to noon. Officials also advise people who feel sick to stay home from work and drink plenty of fluids. We'll have more information after the traffic report.

Good morning, teachers. Before we start, I'd like to explain the new grading system. Starting next semester, report cards will be available online, and parents will receive an email as soon as grades are posted. This means all grades must be entered by the Friday following each exam. I know this deadline is tighter than before, so the technology team will hold two training sessions this week. If you can't attend either, please contact Ms. Rivera to arrange a private session.

Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us to honor Grace Mensah, who is retiring after thirty-two years as head nurse at Riverside Clinic. Grace began here as a part-time assistant, and she worked her way up while studying at night. She trained more than two hundred nurses and started the clinic's first program for new mothers. Tonight, we're delighted to give her this plaque, and I'd like to ask you all to raise a glass. Grace, we will miss you.

Thank you for calling Bluebird Insurance. Our offices are open Monday to Friday from eight to six. If you'd like to report a new claim, press one. To check the status of an existing claim, press two. For billing questions, press three. If you are calling about a medical emergency, please hang up and dial your local emergency number. To hear these options again, press the star key. If you'd like to speak with a representative, please stay on the line, and the next available agent will assist you.

Welcome to today's webinar on retirement planning for young professionals. I'm Marcus Bell, a financial advisor with Greenfield Partners. Many people believe they should wait until they're forty to start saving, but I'll show you why starting in your twenties makes a huge difference. First, we'll look at how compound interest works. Then we'll compare three types of retirement accounts. Please type your questions in the chat box, and I'll answer them in the last ten minutes. A recording will be emailed to all participants tomorrow.

Welcome to the volunteer orientation at Lakeside Hospital. As a volunteer, you'll be helping patients and visitors find their way, delivering flowers, and assisting in the waiting areas. You do not need medical training, but you must wear your badge at all times. Please do not share any patient information with anyone, even family members, unless a nurse has approved it. Your schedule will be posted on the volunteer board by the elevator, and you can swap shifts by calling the coordinator, Ms. Hayes, at least two days in advance.
